title: MPS Chemistry Quarterly Office Hours
summary: Nov 13 2026 3:00PM to Nov 13 2026 4:00PM EST The U.S. National Science Foundation Directorate for Mathematical and Physical Sciences (NSF MPS) supports multiple research programs in chemistry.
